description: What a job pays in Spain across companies: median base, the middle half (p25-p75), median total compensation (base plus bonus and stock) and the share of people at 60,000 EUR base or more, in euros per year, with how many people the figures come from. Every argument is optional and narrows the selection (role, region, years of experience); none gives all of Spain. A figure comes only from 5 or more people: a selection with fewer returns no result and wider_selections, the same selection without years and then without region, to quote instead. For one company use company_salaries, and to rank companies use top_companies. Call list_filters when unsure how a role or region is named.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms, and refer to people by role ("a candidate") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

region.description: Spanish region code or name, e.g. MD, Madrid, CT, Cataluña. Omit, or pass spain or remote, for all of Spain.

role.description: Role slug or name, e.g. software-engineer, Data Scientist, product-manager. Omit for all roles.

years.description: Years of experience, as a number such as 6 or a bucket such as 5-7. Omit for any experience.

name: salary_stats
title: Salary statistics
